python3 - <<'PY'
# Department of Labor Total Outlays (Total funds, in millions of dollars)
fy2011 = 135030  # from treasury_bulletin_2011_12_page_25.txt (September 2011 = end of FY2011)
fy2019 = 35810   # from treasury_bulletin_2019_12_page_22.txt (September 2019 = end of FY2019)

print(f"FY2011: {fy2011} million")
print(f"FY2019: {fy2019} million")

# Number of years from FY2011 to FY2019
years = 2019 - 2011
print(f"Number of years: {years}")

# 1. CAGR = ((end/start)^(1/years) - 1) * 100
cagr = ((fy2019 / fy2011) ** (1 / years) - 1)
print(f"\nCAGR = (( {fy2019}/{fy2011} )^(1/{years}) - 1) = {cagr}")
print(f"CAGR as decimal: {cagr:.10f}")
print(f"CAGR rounded to 3 decimal places: {round(cagr, 3)}")

# 2. Annual decay factor
# "Decay factor" in exponential decay context = (end/start)^(1/years) = 1 + CAGR
decay_factor = (fy2019 / fy2011) ** (1 / years)
print(f"\nAnnual decay factor = (end/start)^(1/years) = {decay_factor}")
print(f"Annual decay factor rounded to 3 decimal places: {round(decay_factor, 3)}")

# 3. Arc elasticity (midpoint method)
# = ((Q2-Q1)/((Q1+Q2)/2)) / ((P2-P1)/((P1+P2)/2))
# Here: Q = outlays, P = year
# Since years change uniformly by 1 each year, P2-P1 = years, P1+P2 = 2011+2019 = 4030
# But the standard arc elasticity with uniform change: ((Q2-Q1)/((Q1+Q2)/2)) / years
# Actually for a single-variable context with just one series:
# Arc elasticity = ((Q2-Q1)/((Q1+Q2)/2))
# The denominator is the midpoint percentage change in the independent variable.
# Since year changes by 8 from 2011 to 2019, midpoint change = 8

# More precisely: arc elasticity = ((Q2-Q1)/((Q1+Q2)/2)) / ((P2-P1)/((P1+P2)/2))
P1, P2 = 2011, 2019
Q1, Q2 = fy2011, fy2019

arc_elasticity = ((Q2 - Q1) / ((Q1 + Q2) / 2)) / ((P2 - P1) / ((P1 + P2) / 2))
print(f"\nArc elasticity = ((Q2-Q1)/((Q1+Q2)/2)) / ((P2-P1)/((P1+P2)/2))")
print(f"                  = (({Q2}-{Q1})/(({Q1}+{Q2})/2)) / (({P2}-{P1})/(({P1}+{P2})/2))")
print(f"                  = (({Q2-Q1})/({(Q1+Q2)/2})) / (({P2-P1})/({(P1+P2)/2}))")
print(f"                  = ({(Q2-Q1)}/{(Q1+Q2)/2}) / ({(P2-P1)}/{(P1+P2)/2})")
print(f"                  = {((Q2-Q1)/((Q1+Q2)/2))} / {((P2-P1)/((P1+P2)/2))}")
print(f"                  = {arc_elasticity}")
print(f"Arc elasticity rounded to 3 decimal places: {round(arc_elasticity, 3)}")

print("\n--- Final Values (3 decimal places) ---")
print(f"CAGR: {round(cagr, 3)}")
print(f"Decay factor: {round(decay_factor, 3)}")
print(f"Arc elasticity: {round(arc_elasticity, 3)}")

result = [round(cagr, 3), round(decay_factor, 3), round(arc_elasticity, 3)]
print(f"\nBracketed result: [{result[0]}, {result[1]}, {result[2]}]")
PY
